open_points.subject: instance_lifecycle listener admission during start
open_points.text: then the listeners at the configured addresses, serving nothing until every check passed
open_points.question: What happens to a connection or request that reaches the owner-interface listener after it is opened but before the service-API listener has either opened successfully or failed: is it queued for service after successful start, or immediately closed/refused without an application response?
options: Bind both listeners without accepting connections, then start both accept loops only after every listener has opened.
Allow the operating system to queue connections and serve them after every listener has opened.
Accept connections during the interval but hold them until startup succeeds, closing them without an answer if startup fails.
Immediately close connections received before startup succeeds.
open_points.default_guess: Bind both listeners synchronously and start neither accept loop until every required listener has opened successfully.

witness.initial: A token-enabled start has opened the owner-interface listener; opening the service-API listener is delayed but will succeed.
events: An owner client connects to the opened owner-interface listener and sends a valid request.
instance_lifecycle finishes opening the service-API listener and the start succeeds.
outcomes: The connection was queued or held and the request is answered after startup succeeds.
The pre-start connection was closed, so the client must reconnect and resend the request.
